title: FRP Composite Boat & Fishing Vessel Design

seo.title: FRP Composite Boat Design | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: Design of composite (FRP) fishing vessels and speedboats: hull lines, laminate structure, stability, resistance and power, approval documents.

fields.headline: Composite boat design: FRP fishing vessels and speedboats
fields.lead: FRP fishing vessels to replace timber hulls, plus speedboats and small craft — laminate structure, stability and power worked out for a light, durable, efficient boat.

items.context: Ageing wood, high upkeep, harder to re-certify.
items.solution: A composite hull with the same function, with structure and stability recalculated for the new material.
Planing hull lines and a resistance and power estimate to choose the right engine.

fields.heading: What you receive
fields.intro: A design set for mould-building and plan approval.
fields.note: Lead time is agreed with the quote, depending on vessel type, scope and existing documents. You know each delivery date in advance.

items.title: Lines plan and general arrangement
items.desc: Matched to the yard’s moulding process

steps.title: Send us the brief
steps.desc: Vessel type, target dimensions, operating area and any photos or documents you have.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.desc: We agree the scope, deliverables and schedule, with a clear price for each part.

steps.title: Design and calculations
steps.desc: Drawings and calculations with industry software and our own engineering tools.

steps.title: Review and handover

items.title: Is a composite hull as durable as steel or wood?
items.content: With a correctly calculated laminate and proper building practice, an FRP hull is light, rot-free and low-maintenance.

fields.heading: Building a composite boat?
fields.description: Call us with the purpose, target size and the yard that will build it.
